status: Exploratory stability rerun on the registered MatPhys source/target split.

triggering_failure.diagnosis: The fixed v1 checkpoint had 155939 non-finite model values and 710400 non-finite optimizer values; source loss at epoch 5 was 5.73 times epoch 1.

timing: Locked after generating the registered target causal-prefix proxy and observing a checkpoint-finiteness failure, but before any target prefix metric, target future rollout, target future observation, or target outcome was opened.

initialization.rule: Load the public source-trained MatPhys representation but exclude spring_base.5, ctrl_spring_base.5, and spring_mod. The excluded residual heads remain exactly zero, so the initial physical field is byte-equivalent to the released per-case PhysTwin teacher.

scientific_change.rationale: The public model's absolute output is a rejected causal input shortcut, but its source-trained representation is reusable after the absolute spring heads are reset. A tenfold lower learning rate, explicit teacher shrinkage, and transactional finite updates directly address the source-only v1 instability while preserving the exact-teacher fallback.

target_proxy.evidence: four uniformly sampled RGB frames strictly before each registered 75 percent target-prefix boundary

competence_gate.source: The terminal checkpoint and optimizer state must be fully finite, all source losses finite, and the applied source spring field nondegenerate.
competence_gate.target: Only the locked disjoint target-prefix family gate may select learned versus exact teacher per case; ties and regressions select teacher.
competence_gate.future: No target future is opened unless the source competence gate and target-prefix family gate artifacts validate.
